description: Rust-routed HTTP for the tournament-admin window ONLY. Requests made through tauri-plugin-http originate from Rust, so they carry no browser origin — no CORS preflight and no CSP connect-src check. Scoped to the loopback admin ports: 8090 (LOCAL backend) and 8091 (PRODUCTION, forwarded over the SSH tunnel). No public/remote host is reachable through this.
